ORDINANCENO.
ENTITLED:“AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 2.76.020,
MEMBERS-TERMS-VACANCIES, OFCHAPTER2.76, DOWNTOWN
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, OF TITLE 2, ADMINISTRATION AND
PERSONNEL, OF THE MUNICIPAL CODE OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section1.That Section 2.76.020, Members-Terms-Vacancies, of Chapter2.76, Downtown
Development Authority, of Title 2, Administration and Personnel, ishereby amended as set out in
this ordinance.
2.76.020
Members-Terms-Vacancies.
A.
The affairs of the authority shall be under the direct supervision and control of a
board consisting of nine ten members appointed by the mayor with the advice and consent of the
governing body.A majority of the members, except any member from the governing body, shall
reside, be a lessee or own property in the downtown development district.
B.
Theboard shall be constituted asfollows:
1.
At least one member shall be a member of the governing body appointed to
serve at the pleasure of the governing body; and
2.
Nine members shall be appointed by the Mayor in accordance with the By-
Laws of the Downtown Development Authority.
2.
Two-members shall be appointed for a term expiring June-30, 2015,
.
Four members shall be appointed for a term expiring June 30, 2017, and
4.
Two members shall be appointed for a term expiring June 30, 2018.
C.A member shall hold office until his or her successor has been appointed and
qualified.After the terms of the initial members have expired, theterms of all members, except the
appointed members of the governing body, shall expire four years from the expiration date of the
terms oftheir predecessors.Appointments tofill vacancies shall beforthe unexpired term, and shall
be made within thirty (30) days after the occurrence of the vacancy.
D.Board members shall serve without compensation, but may be reimbursed for actual
and necessary expenses.
Section2.That sections currently existing in Chapter 2.76 not set out within this ordinance
remain unchanged.
Section 3.That this ordinance shall become effective upon its passage and publication.
